scope: Geometric comparison of Pacific Electric line observations in the Brooks–Lutz 1915 and 1928 GIS files.
excluded: 1928-PEpoints_2011-06-26 was not imported; this comparison contains line geometry, not a stop inventory.
comparison: Same classifier as LARy: five-metre flat-ended buffers around segments whose absolute direction difference is at most twenty degrees, computed in EPSG:26911. Exact display duplicates are dissolved; source records and provenance remain in hidden observations.
limitations: The 1915 PE source covers a smaller area than the 1928 source. An absent line may be outside source coverage rather than absent historically.
Period-only classifications describe these source files, not verified construction or abandonment dates.
Near-parallel tracks within five metres can match; digitizing offsets larger than five metres may look period-only.
The source files do not establish full regional PE extent or every historical track.
